_readme: The ONLY hand-maintained data in the generator. Everything else is read from vanilla data. Each entry is validated against the vanilla files on every run (unknown textures/sounds abort the run).

supplementBlocks._why: Blocks the engine hard-codes, so vanilla blocks.json has no entry for them. (grass_block is deliberately absent: its side is a tinted overlay layered over dirt and cannot be shown with one texture.)

tint._why: Biome tinting is applied by the engine, not described in any data file. Values: none, default_foliage, birch_foliage, evergreen_foliage, dry_foliage, grass, water.

render._why: Force a render class for a block name (opaque | alpha_test | blend) instead of reading texture alpha.

shapes._why: Per-shape overrides of what the wrench may do. Defaults come from the base block's own states/traits.
